dedupeText: mid century soul portrait layout 1960s halftone grain warm palette tight crop portrait serif typography ochre background subject profile creates a strong diagonal from bottom left to top right typography is anchored to the negative space of the subject s face high contrast shadows in the subject harmonize with the dark hair and clothing details warm ochre background provides a vibrant foil to the cool white of the teeth and collar take a high grain profile portrait place against solid warm background overlay centered high contrast serif type in all caps

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned profile portrait of a male performer, featuring heavy film grain and a tight crop that emphasizes facial expression. The subject is set against a flat, saturated ochre background with centered, stacked typography placed over the cheek area.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject profile creates a strong diagonal from bottom-left to top-right
Typography is anchored to the negative space of the subject's face
High-contrast shadows in the subject harmonize with the dark hair and clothing details
Warm ochre background provides a vibrant foil to the cool white of the teeth and collar
coreInvariants: Heavy, visible halftone or film grain texture
Tight profile crop cutting off the top of the head and back of the neck

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying 80% of the frame, positioned slightly left-of-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white area of the subject's smile and collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright smile, moves up the bridge of the nose to the typography, then follows the curve of the head down to the collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; concentrated in the upper left and right corners in a solid ochre hue.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high value contrast in the subject's features.

composition.position: Upper right quadrant, over subject's face

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color shifts to distinguish title from artist name.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the sharp serifs and high contrast of 1960s display type.
Provides the necessary vertical stress and hairline thinness.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy film portrait of a man in profile, smiling, against a solid ochre background. The lighting should be warm and directional, creating deep shadows. Apply a vintage halftone texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center-align two blocks of all-caps serif text in the upper right. Use a thin horizontal line between the blocks. The top block should be yellow, the bottom block white. Use tight kerning.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible and consistent?
Is the background a flat, saturated ochre?
Is the typography centered and stacked?
Does the subject's profile dominate the frame?

mustRedesign: Specific logos or record label symbols
Exact facial features of the original performer
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the subject's skin tone.
Verify the halftone pattern doesn't obscure facial expressions.
Check that the ochre color feels 'vintage' rather than neon.
Confirm the profile silhouette is sharp and clear.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-grain profile portrait + place against solid warm background + overlay centered high-contrast serif type in all-caps.
